column2: This is a school.
Here, everyone can receive the same education for free regardless of $$羽$$ color!
After all, children's education is the foundation of a prosperous society!
In our city, hospitals, schools, and all other facilities everyone uses are free!
In that wretched city of Sodom, I hear only the rich receive adequate medical care,
while the poor die without receiving much care at all...
Can such a system really be called $$平等$$!?
This city's affairs are discussed by fine people who worked hard to create it,
and developed through long-term plans to make it easier for everyone to live.
If city leaders changed on a whim as they do in Sodom,
there could be no long-term management of the city!
Even if a great famine were to continue for ten years,
this storehouse has enough food to feed every resident.
By making long-term production plans,
and having every worker cooperate, we alone can achieve this level of productivity.
Everyone works $$平等$$ly for the city, and the money gathered is distributed fairly.
There is no discrimination among any kinds of labor,
nor any mistaken sense that some jobs are admirable and others shameful.
Such things do not exist at all in this city.
Every worker's sweat is equally beautiful!!
This is Gomorrah, the City of Peace!
Some call it the City of $$怠惰$$, but...
This city is a very fine place!
Everyone truly lives in $$平等$$!!
Here, farmers, bakers, and even cleaning ladies,
schoolteachers and $$医者$$s alike,
are all civil servants of the same city and receive the same wages.
Do you not think that is wonderfully $$平等$$!?
Found you!
So this is where you snuck off to!!
Why am I not working? I met today's quota!
Whether I work or slack off, I end up with the same standard of living.
Working hard is just stupid!!
Go on, get out of here! Someone will find out I'm slacking!
